changes: Removed the gameplay-preview screen and all preview-mode toggles from the theme mockup.
Warm red is labeled 已拥有.
Theme name, coin price and owned-piece count are placed inside each card.
Removed the large lower theme summary and duplicate billing text.
The second panel demonstrates vertical theme-card scrolling with fixed preview and purchase action.
Detailed full value, owned deduction, payment and remaining balance are shown only in the purchase modal.
The four original main tabs and individual shopping routes are preserved.
review: Four first-release themes are shown on the first screen.
The middle screen is a future expanded-list illustration, not an expanded release commitment.
Scrolled card content is clipped inside the list and stays above the fixed purchase button.
All depicted prices are illustrative and do not modify the existing economy.
Production page code, pricing and saves were not changed.
